convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Signal3EMA.mqh) for core trading signal logic which must be manually examined and reimplemented; remaining dependencies (Expert.mqh, TrailingNone.mqh, MoneyFixedLot.mqh) are standard MQL5 Standard Library but still require conversion

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MoneyFixedLot uses Percent for risk fraction when Lots>0 acts as fixed lot; Percent=10.0 is the deposit fraction fallback

custom_logic_notes: CSignal3EMA logic is encapsulated in external Signal3EMA.mqh - the exact crossover confirmation logic (whether it uses previous bar values [1]/[2] or current bar [0], and whether both EMA conditions must align simultaneously) is not visible in this file. CExpert base class from Standard Library handles position management, signal reversal, and margin checks internally. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar close, not on every tick.
python_conversion_notes: The CExpert/CSignal3EMA Standard Library framework must be fully unwound: (1) Read Signal3EMA.mqh to extract exact LongCondition/ShortCondition logic including which bar shifts ([0] vs [1]) are used for crossover detection; (2) SL/TP of 400/900 are in POINTS not pips - need digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers); (3) CExpert internally checks for existing positions before entry - replicate with position check before order; (4) Expert_EveryTick=false means evaluate on new bar only - implement new_bar_guard; (5) CMoneyFixedLot with Lots=0.1 and Percent=10.0: when Lots>0 it trades fixed lot size, Percent is only used if Lots=0; (6) Signal reversal close is handled by CExpert when opposite signal detected - must implement explicit opposite signal close before entry.
